product_summary: Live e-commerce catalogue (kruticoffee.com/collections/all, 30 SKUs in stock) shows: roasted whole-bean single origins and blends in 100 g / 250 g packs (Kindiriguda Naturals, Deomali Special, Attikan Morning Mist, Gungegiri Twilight, Paraja Strong, Koraput Tropical Bloom, Kalinga Gold, Bhubaneswar Blend, Koraput Arabica Blend); drip bags / dip bags (pack of 5, pack of 10); assorted festival gift boxes and hampers; and 100% soy scented coffee candles (Hot Macchiato, Iced Americano). About page (kruticoffee.com/pages/about-us) states the company runs a specialty coffee roastery and cafe chain in Bhubaneswar ('Select by Kruti Coffee'), sources green beans from Indian growing regions, roasts its entire inventory to SCA standards, and also handles black pepper from its Kindiriguda panel farms. No green (unroasted) bean line is offered for sale on the site.
role_hint: manufacturer_trader — own roastery and cafe chain (manufacturer/processor of roasted coffee), plus retail/D2C and B2B resale of sourced green beans and third-party-origin microlots (e.g. 'Koraput Tropical Bloom ... From The House Of Madhu Agro' is a third-party brand resold).
comment: Declared 090121 (coffee, roasted, not decaffeinated) is CORRECT for the core line — the bulk of the catalogue is roasted, non-decaffeinated whole-bean coffee and roasted-coffee drip bags, so the code is retained, not rejected (Rule 3). Match is 'partial' only because the declaration is narrower than the actual assortment: (1) 090122 — roasted decaffeinated coffee: no decaf SKU visible in the 30-item catalogue, so this subheading is not evidenced and is not claimed; (2) 210130 — roasted coffee substitutes / extracts-type preparations: not evidenced, not claimed; (3) 090190 — coffee husks and skins / other coffee: not evidenced, not claimed; (4) 340600 — candles: the soy scented coffee candles (Rs. 449) are a genuine non-coffee product line absent from the declaration and would fall under 3406.00, not Chapter 9. Drip bags are roasted coffee in filter sachets and remain 090121 (packaging does not shift the heading). Black pepper mentioned on the About page is a farm-side activity with no pepper SKU in the catalogue, so it is not added to the HS list. Industry label 'Продукты питания и FMCG' is broadly right but understates the specialty-coffee roastery/manufacturing and cafe-services component; the candles line is non-food FMCG. Trader signs: resale of third-party-branded microlots (Madhu Agro) and a B2B wholesale channel alongside own roasting. IMPORTANT per project rules: all of the above is catalogue/website evidence only — no customs line was available to me in this task, therefore every product and every HS code here is 'заявлено, не подтверждено' (declared, not confirmed); actual export/internal shipment records were not researched by me (out of scope for this role). No registry, revenue, CIN or PAN data was checked or asserted; PAN and state fields were empty in the input and remain null.
